issue_request: FHIR-7741 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request for DSTU1 MedicationPrescription asking whether an example was needed for MedicationPrescription.dosageInstruction.site when represented as a CodeableConcept; the recorded resolution was to add an example.
initial_application: No current git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-7741. The apparent application was commit 65be5a01c7, which added MedicationOrder examples including medicationorder0329.xml with a coded siteCodeableConcept for SNOMED CT 72098002, followed by commit 7387b2894c, which renamed MedicationOrder to MedicationRequest and preserved the example as medicationrequest0329.xml.
additional_context: MedicationPrescription is no longer a current resource name; MedicationRequest is active in source/fhir.ini. The current MedicationRequest example list and examples header publish medicationrequest0329, and current examples such as medicationrequest0329.xml and medicationrequest0323.xml contain coded Dosage.site values. Later FHIR-54848 changed Dosage.site to CodeableReference(BodyStructure) while preserving coded concept usage, explaining the current <site><coding> shape. FHIR-10066 was reviewed as related background about route/site placement and examples but does not require a separate reconciliation here.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. The current authoritative source already supplies the requested example coverage in build scope, so adding another source example would be redundant.
